description: Model and data for "Extending energy system modelling to include extreme weather risks and application to hurricane events in Puerto Rico is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Jeffrey A. Bennett, Joseph F. DeCarolis. This archive includes the model and data used to produce the publication "Extending energy system modelling to include extreme weather risks and application to hurricane events in Puerto Rico" by Bennett et al. Coverage: national (PR); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
